records.issue_text: GroupTest race test is non-deterministic: nothing guarantees the reader observes a group between cache lookup and delete, and nothing asserts the reader ran at least once, so a green run does not prove the race was exercised. Add a minimum completed-read count or a deterministic test with a GroupAdapter whose supplier returns null.
records.rationale: The added test `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti` starts a reader thread that loops until `deletedAll` is set, but the test never waits for the thread to perform at least one read (no counter/latch) and never joins the thread.
